question: select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution: The correct answer is '**called**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**called**'. • It means** 'to have a particular name'.** (कोई विशेष नाम होना) • *Example: His wife is **called** Sandhya.* • In the given context,** 'computer programmer** is also called** software developer**'. • Hence, '**called**' fits the best. **Correct Paragraph:__** *A computer programmer, sometimes **__called__ **software developer, a programmer or more recently a coder, (2)_____ a person who creates computer software. The term ‘computer programmer’ can (3)____ to a specialist in the area of computers, or to a generalist (4)_____ writes codes for many kinds of software. Some programmers who (5)_____ web programming languages add a prefix, a suffix, or both to every page's title.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Accepted**: to agree to take something that somebody offers you. [(दी गई वस्‍तु को) स्‍वीकार या ग्रहण करना] • **Said**: to speak or tell somebody something, using words. [(शब्‍दों की सहायता से) (किसी को कुछ) कहना; बोलना] • **Known**: to have knowledge or information in your mind. [किसी बात या व्‍यक्ति की जानकारी होना] 43:T6ff, The correct answer is '**is**'.
